placements.why: Segments src-1 and src-2 define the reproduction test case and specify the non-negotiable requirement that slug derivation must produce a valid slug without crashing when an explicit id is missing.
placements.title: Deterministic slug derivation guarantees ingestion pipeline stability on missing memory identifiers
placements.frame: How must the ingestion pipeline derive valid slugs and prevent crashes when memories omit an explicit id field?
